parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` within the `Artwork` package. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.828 indicates structurally near-duplicate test methods, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.fetchAlbumArtworkSuccess` (line 314) and `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.skipsSpacerGifImages` (line 360) are distinct test cases exercising different behavioural scenarios — successful artwork fetching versus spacer-GIF filtering — whose structural similarity is a natural consequence of sharing the same test scaffolding (arrange/act/assert boilerplate). Collapsing them would obscure test intent and make failure diagnosis harder. Per decision rule 1, all participating records being test fixtures mandates a no-action recommendation.
